episodes.source_context: C042 exact G9/G13 semantic activation and twin-quotient collapse

relations: word splits into row prefix and suffix
row label indexes a complement star
failure_mechanisms: early semantic signal can remain concentrated in few neighborhood types
desired_transition: produce source-valid upper bound before lower-bound search

episodes.transformation_name: exact neighborhood quotient before lower-bound search
episodes.operation: partition both sides by full complement-neighborhood equality, prove block constancy and lift a quotient/type-class cover
preconditions: exact quotient classes have constant adjacency on each class product
class maps are surjective and all classes nonempty
the full associated-graph cover lifts from the quotient in the upper-bound direction
resulting_relations: produce source-valid upper bound before lower-bound search
known_breakpoints: adjacency varies inside a proposed class
an asserted type omits accumulated old-band neighbors
later quotient size or cover growth is uncontrolled

episodes.source_context: Lions concentration-compactness, locally compact case: local compactness on unbounded domains is separated from concentration/tightness/escape phenomena.

relations: global quantity may escape through the tail
constraints: local compactness alone is insufficient for a global compactness conclusion
failure_mechanisms: loss of global mass or boundary control
desired_transition: separate local compactness from tail control and test an explicit tightness condition before global passage

episodes.operation: Do not glue local convergence directly to a global conclusion; introduce an explicit tail/tightness coordinate and test it before the global passage.
preconditions: global target can be affected by escape at infinity
resulting_relations: local convergence and tail control are separately typed obligations
global passage is conditional on the tail/tightness test
known_breakpoints: signed/nonpositive target quantities may need a tailored absolute-uniform-integrability surrogate
PDE dynamics can supply additional structure not captured by generic compactness
evidence_pointers: P.-L. Lions, Ann. IHP C Analyse non lineaire 1 (1984), 109-145
